{{SameName|Bat|[[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Nightmare Carnival]] • [[Bat (Trick or Threat Town)|Trick or Threat Town]] • [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Solar Eclipse]]}} {{EventEnded|date=26th of January 2022|event=[[Solar Eclipse Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Bat |image1 = batSE.png |mode_appearance = [[Tower Outskirts|Solar Eclipse Night III]]
[[Totality Tower|Solar Eclipse Night IV]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (4.5) |spawned_by = [[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]] |hidden = No |fly = {{Attr|Fly|Yes}} |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bat''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It did not spawn naturally and was instead spawned by the [[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]] on death. While it had lower health than the [[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]], it had faster speed. Additionally, it was a [[Flying]] enemy, so most towers could not attack it. ==Appearance== The '''Bat''' was a humanoid bat. It had dark purple skin with fur around its neck and black bat wings. It also had purple hair and red glowing eyes. ==Strategy== *Towers such as the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this enemy. **These towers can also deal splash damage, allowing them to clear out hordes of '''Bats''' faster. *The [[Ranger]] and [[Hunter]], paired with the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability, can perform well against these enemies. *The [[Mortar]] may not be a very good choice because of its slow firerate and lack of damage. **Additionally, [[Mortar]]'s projectile explodes on the ground. At low levels, the [[Mortar]] may only deal small amounts of damage to the '''Bat'''. *The '''Bat''' can get hit by a Level 4+ [[Electroshocker]] in its chain reaction. *The [[Pyromancer]] can set this on fire if there is another detectable enemy near it. **However, it can only set the '''Bat''' on fire at Level 5, as the flames are too small to hit the '''Bat''' at any level below Level 5. *Despite being a flying enemy, [[units]] from the {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Military Base]] and from the regular [[Crook Boss]] can still collide with it, though they cannot detect it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Bat''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Bat''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. **Health increased from 80 to 100. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Bat''' removed. {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Bat}}
